records.title: Retention policy for replay-grade market snapshot history

body.rationale: EXP-0001 shows only ~45 days of full-fidelity instrument snapshots and ~51 days of heatmap history exist, far short of a 6-month replay goal. Compaction (hourly gzip archival) preserves history today, but prune_generated_state.py defaults would delete 627 artifacts (~1.1GB) if applied. Recommend: (1) disable or raise prune thresholds to 180 days or -1 for both instrument-snapshot-archives and relative-value-history; (2) keep compact_instrument_snapshots.py as-is (archive-only, never delete); (3) build replay harness to read archives not just hot JSONL; (4) do not run prune --apply until operator approves. Estimated retention cost: ~1.0-1.3 GB/month combined (snapshots ~1.0 GB/mo at ~1.6 MB/hour gz + RVH ~150 MB/mo). With 9.2 GB free, 180-day retention (~6 GB) is feasible without disk upgrade; 365-day would need monitoring or larger volume.

instrumentSnapshotArchives.action: raise prune --snapshot-archive-days to 180 or -1; never delete via manual prune without review

hotInstrumentSnapshots.action: no change; compaction already archives to gz

dailyValuationsMacro.action: keep append-only; fix merge-conflict tip rows separately

fundingHistory.action: derive from instrument snapshots; consider optional standalone funding JSONL export for lighter replays

pruneAutomation.action: do not schedule prune_generated_state.py --apply until policy approved

records.title: EXP: ex-ante confidence calibration audit (live trades, shadows, hypotheses)

body.question: Is the trading system's ex-ante confidence/probability well-calibrated against realized win rates, and which trade/shadow populations have a recoverable ex-ante confidence to test this at all?
body.method: scripts/confidence_calibration.py (stdlib-only) audits every candidate confidence source named in the Phase 3 brief by reading scripts/trading-engine.ts's Position/ClosedTrade interfaces and every named data file. It joins three verified-joinable sources to realized outcomes, buckets observations into fixed 0.2-wide confidence buckets, and computes gap = realizedWinRate - meanConfidence per (source, bucket). Excludes trades with close_reason=data_quality_artifact or id in operationally-tainted-trades.json, and shadows with hypotheticalResult.closeReason=data_quality_artifact or an unresolved outcome.

joinable: data/blocked-signals.json: 818 resolved shadow trades carry an ex-ante `confidence` (recorded at blockedAt) joined to hypotheticalResult.outcome (win/loss); 32 excluded as data_quality_artifact/unresolved. Spans 9 blockedReason families.
data/hypotheses.json: 581 triggered test events joined to each hypothesis's static ex-ante `confidence` (531 hypotheses, all with numeric confidence).
52 of 482 closed live trades (10.8%) join via a non-empty hypothesis_id to hypotheses.json confidence, after excluding 28 tainted/data_quality_artifact trades.
notJoinable: 402 of 482 closed live trades (89.2%) have NO recoverable ex-ante confidence: verified by reading the Position and ClosedTrade TypeScript interfaces in scripts/trading-engine.ts — neither persists a confidence/probability field — and trades-detailed.csv has no confidence column. Confidence is computed transiently in signal-generation code (e.g. `confidence: strength * weight.weight`) but discarded once a position opens.

data/candidate-actions.json entryCandidates[].confidence is real ex-ante confidence but the file is overwritten every engine run (current snapshot only, no history) — past candidates can't be joined back to the trades opened from them.
data/engine-state.json openPositions and data/position-snapshots.csv are derived point-in-time summaries with no confidence field.
data/calibration-buckets-summary.json stores only realized winRate for NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW shadows with no confidence field — outcome-only, not a calibration input.
data/llm-close-rejections.json, data/llm-state.json, data/llm-advice.json are operational logs of close decisions/skips; none store an entry-time win probability.

keyFindings: Systemic overconfidence at high confidence in hypothesis-derived populations: hypotheses_test_level bucket 0.6-0.8 (n=479) predicts 0.686 but realizes 0.399 (gap -0.287), and bucket 0.8-1.0 (n=99) predicts 0.818 but realizes 0.444 (gap -0.373). The same pattern repeats in the live-trade subset traceable to a hypothesis (live_trades_via_hypothesis 0.8-1.0, n=46, predicts 0.823, realizes 0.435, gap -0.388) — 'high confidence' hypotheses win less than half the time in both the paper test-event population and the live trades linked to them.

shadow:weekend_hl_funding_shadow is the single largest bucket in the dataset (n=254, confidence clustered at ~0.50) and realizes a 74.4% win rate — gap +0.244, substantially underconfident. This is the strategy backing STRAT-0001 (currently active live).

shadow:short_blocked_by_positive_trend at confidence 0.0-0.2 (n=23) realizes a 56.5% win rate versus a predicted 7.4% (gap +0.491): signals the engine blocks specifically for having low computed confidence actually win more than half the time in this sample.

records.title: Persist ex-ante confidence per trade on live positions/ledger

body.rationale: EXP-0003 found that 89.2% of closed live trades have zero recoverable ex-ante confidence: scripts/trading-engine.ts's Position and ClosedTrade interfaces never persist the confidence value that IS computed at signal-generation time (e.g. `confidence: strength * weight.weight`), and trades-detailed.csv has no confidence column. The only live-trade confidence signal available today is an indirect, coarse proxy: joining via hypothesis_id to a hypothesis's single static confidence value (10.8% coverage). Meanwhile the shadow-trade population (blocked-signals.json) shows this is a solvable problem — it already persists confidence per shadow instance at blockedAt and enables real calibration analysis today. Persisting the same per-instance ex-ante confidence on live Position/ClosedTrade records (not just the hypothesis's static value) would let calibration audits, Kelly-sizing work, and signal-weight tuning use the full live population instead of an ~11% joinable slice.
body.proposedChange: Add a `confidence: number` field to the Position and ClosedTrade interfaces in scripts/trading-engine.ts, populated from the signal's `confidence` at the moment a position is opened (the same value already computed and used for sizing/ranking), and add a matching `confidence` column to trades-detailed.csv's writer/reader so it survives to the ledger. No change to sizing, entry logic, stops, or targets.
